scope: CPU-only read-only verification of the completed protected 10-update QAT artifacts, all committed checkpoints, source closure, optimizer/history state, exported integer package, support receipts, watchdog telemetry, and the already-completed development17 result. No evaluator, training, CUDA, or GPU operation was run by this review.

verdict.summary: The ten-update run is internally complete, source-bound, finite, and exactly exported, but it materially worsened the frozen same-17 development metrics and failed the predeclared restoration gate. Artifact correctness does not rescue the candidate's failed quality result.

findings.finding: The protected worker completed exactly ten updates with exit code 0 and no automatic retry or continuation.

All committed candidate states validate against the frozen dataset, replay schedule, identity, protocol, cursor, presentation count, candidate kind, and formal-acceptance flag. Histories are exact prefixes and all recorded losses, foreground counts, pre-clip gradient norms, update durations, model tensors, optimizer tensors, and RNG tensors are finite.

The corrected CPU integration artifact is a non-candidate state and validates only with expected_candidate=false; every actual run checkpoint is candidate=true and validates with expected_candidate=true. The older root-level CPU receipt is explicitly superseded and was not used.
The final checkpoint re-encodes exactly to every actual integer parameter array loaded from the exported package.
The training identity closes over all current sources and immutable execution snapshots, and all support receipts bind to the same identity.
The independent watchdog remained bound to the intended RTX 4060 UUID and did not approach the 75 C stop threshold.

The already-completed same-17 integer evaluation is correctly bound to the final checkpoint/package and identical GT, ignores, postprocess settings, validation manifest, FP32 baseline, and maxabs-PTQ baseline, but both class AP50 values fell below maxabs PTQ and far below FP32.
findings.required_disposition: Stop this candidate path. Do not continue training, revive the old256 continuation, or label the package deployment-ready from these artifacts.

methods: Rebuilt the current identity with train_qat.prepare on CPU and matched training_contract identity/protocol.
Applied train_qat.validate_state to update_0000 through update_0010 with expected_candidate=true and to the corrected CPU checkpoint with expected_candidate=false.
Checked complete history prefixes, finite model/optimizer/RNG state, per-update sample/group/count fields, and checkpoint hashes.
Loaded the final state into QATExactModel, re-encoded integer_parameters, loaded the exported package through its strict loader, and compared every layer/field with numpy exact equality.
Recomputed current-source, execution-snapshot, receipt/log, package, validation, FP32 baseline, and PTQ baseline hashes.
Compared evaluation truth, ignores, and postprocess contracts exactly with both frozen baselines.
not_run: No training, optimizer step, forward pass, CUDA query, or GPU operation.
No source, checkpoint, package, cache, evaluation, or prior receipt modification.
